_readme: Living-portrait v4 (FFX-2 only): two picks per yaw from rounds r1/r2 of tools/gen/lora-keys.mjs (LoRA yuna-x2 step 2000). Sign: negative yaw = face turned toward screen-left (rig.json turn-l85 = -85). Candidates live in D:/Tools/pyrefly-lora/yuna-x2/cand/<round>/yaw<N>/c<i>.png with their sidecars; the picks are copied here as lossless webp + sidecar.
